product.name: Climaflex Polyethylene Pipe Insulation 1m Lengths
product.description: Climaflex is a flexible polyethylene foam based closed cell pipe insulation suitable for a broad range of water and heating applications, frost protection and impact protection. It can be glued, taped or simply pushed together to form an insulated pipe, making it a convenient, versatile option. Available in 1mtr segments and multiple pipe sizes, Climaflex pipe insulation combines high performance and low cost in most domestic applications, giving you the best of both worlds. While you can also use it externally, keep in mind that it will degrade faster in sunlight.What’s more, Climaflex pipe insulation is a sustainable, environmentally friendly solution that is completely CFC (chlorofluorocarbon) and HCFC (hydrochlorofluorocarbon) free and has an ODP (ozone depletion potential) of zero. It can accommodate temperatures ranging from -45 °C to +105 °C and has excellent thermal conductivity. product.name: Climaflex Polyethylene Pipe Insulation 2m Lengths - 13mm (Full Box)
product.description: These boxes of Climaflex pipe insulation is an effective, cost-effective way to stock up on this excellent polyethylene-based foam system. product.name: Honeywell Home V4073A Motorised Mid Position Diverter Valve
product.description:
The V4073A Valve has been designed to control the flow of water in domestic central heating systems, where both radiator and hot water cylinder circuits are pumped. It is typically suited for small to medium sized installations. The Mid-position Diverter Valve should be used in conjunction with a room thermostat and cylinder thermostat to provide full temperature control of a conventional, fully pumped central heating installation. When used in this way, the control system is known as Sundial Y Plan and the components can be connected together using the Sundial Plan Wiring Centre which has dedicated terminations and there is no need for a wiring diagram.

An alternative method of wiring is to use the Honeywell 10-way Junction Box (42002116-002) together with the Honeywell Sundial Plans Wiring Booklet.Features & Benefits: Honeywell Home V4073A Motorised Mid Position Diverter ValveSpring return actionThree position operationPowerhead replaceable without draining downManual lever for filling/draining downQuiet operation, minimal power consumptionProvides electrical output to boiler and/or pump
product.variant_name: DISCO - Honeywell Home V4073A1088 Motorised Mid Position 28mm Diverter Valve

product.description:
The BA295S backflow preventer protects drinking water systems against back pressure, backflow and back siphonage. Typically, these valves are to be fitted inline to the supplies of commercial washing machines, restaurant kitchens and industrial processes. KIWA approved.

product.name: Lindab Magestic Half Round Galvanised Steel Downpipe Branch
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe Rectangular Rainwater Head
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Alumasc Herritage Aluminium Circular Pipe Shoe
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Mira JUMP White Electric Shower
product.description: The Mira Jump White Electric Shower offers versatile installation with up to 36 combinations, making it perfect for replacing existing electric showers in bathrooms, wet rooms, and en-suites. product.name: DEKTITE Diverter EPDM Pipe Flashing for Metal Roofs
product.description: As a highly durable synthetic rubber roofing membrane flashing solution, the large base of this grey EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Terpolymer) flashing for metal roofs dramatically reduces and, as the name suggests, diverts rainwater pooling. This is a common occurrence on both very low and high-pitched roofs as well as deep-ribbed roofing profiles.It gets better. Specifically designed for use on high and low roof pitches, this DEKTITE Diverter is suitable for use on a roof pitch between 0° and 60° and is easy to install. product.name: MDPE Blue Pipe Coil Main Water Supply
product.description:
Manufactured from long-lasting, corrosion-free MDPE, otherwise known as alkathene, this range of pipe coils is ideal for below-ground distribution of potable water. Flexible, lightweight and straightforward to install, they are fully compatible with a wide range of push-fit fittings.
Suitable for use in pipeline rehabilitation installations, this MDPE pipe can also be utilised for open-cut and no-dig applications. With a 2.3mm thick solid wall, it features a colour-coded PE80 light blue exterior and PE80 black inner layer.
Features & Benefits: MDPE Blue Pipe Coil Main Water SupplyIdeal for below-ground potable water mains supply distribution12.5 bar maximum operating pressureManufactured from corrosion-free MDPE for longer lifePE80 blue exterior and PE80 black interiorAvailable in various lengths and diameters2.3mm wall thicknessFully compatible with a wide range of push-fit fittingsLightweight, flexible and straightforward to installComplies with BS EN 12201, WRAS approved and SDR 11-rated
Standards & CertificationBSI approved (Kitemarked) to BS EN 12201-2-2011 + A1-2013Regulation 31 of the Water Supply (Water Quality) Regulations 2000: Approved
Please note: For above-ground water distributions, use black HDPE instead of blue MDPE.If BS 6572 is specified, use BS EN 12201 pipework.

product.name: Armaflex Pipe Insulation - 2m Lengths
product.description: This Class O Armaflex pipe insulation from Armacell is manufactured from nitrile rubber to provide insulation for pipes for a range of applications. You can fit this pipe insulation as you install pipes for hot and cold water services, chilled water lines, ductwork, refrigerated pipework, and more. This Armaflex pipe insulation is flexible yet durable so easy to slip over pipes quickly without the worry of damaging the insulation or the pipes. It reduces frost on pipes, conserves energy and also controls levels of condensation so you can save money on bills and on repair work that might stem from frost or condensation damages. Dust and fibre free, during the manufacturing process a vapour barrier is built into this pipe insulation for extra energy conservation.Features & Benefits: Armaflex Pipe Insulation - 2m LengthsMade from foamed nitrile rubber with a vapour barrierPrevents frost on pipes, condensation and energy lossDust and fibre-freeThe excellent fire safety performance of this pipe insulation product has demonstrated a zero surface spread of flame and so it is recommended to combat thermal bridging. It also incorporates some acoustic insulation benefits by reducing the noise of water and air travelling through pipes. This Armaflex pipe insulation comes in 2m lengths however a range of pipe sizes and wall thicknesses are offered to get the best system for you.

product.name: DeWalt Laser Black Safety Hiker
product.description: Perfect if you're working within the construction or engineering industry, these DeWalt Laser Black Safety Hikers are safety boots based on the robust and sturdy hiking boot design, providing you with high levels of protection, comfort and durability.With a stylish, hardwearing black full-grain leather upper, these Laser Black Safety Hikers feature a padded tongue and collar for maximum comfort and support. The 200-joule steel toe cap will also protect your feet from falling heavy loads.Features & Benefits: DeWalt Laser Black Safety HikerSafety boot based on the robust and sturdy hiking boot designS1P safety ratingIdeal if you're working within the construction or engineering industryPadded tongue and collar for maximum comfort200-joule steel toe cap and steel midsoleHeel support and dual-density outsole, made from strong and flexible TPUAnti-static energy absorption technologyAvailable in multiple sizesThese boots' heel support and dual-density outsole is made from Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU), a strong, abrasion-resistant and flexible material. For additional protection underfoot, the steel midsole will also protect your feet from sharp objects.The anti-static energy absorption technology within these boots will conduct static electricity, keeping you safe from the risk of static sparks, which can be incredibly dangerous if working around flammable liquids and gasses.Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 20345: 2011 S1PSlip Resistance: SRCPlease note: This footwear has been tested on clay tiles with a sodium lauryl sulphate solution and meets a minimum Coefficient of Friction (CoF) of 0.32 tested flat and a CoF of 0.28 when tested at the heel.This footwear is also tested on stainless steel with a glycerol solution and meets a CoF of 0.18 when tested flat and 0.13 at the heel.

product.name: Vaillant Green IQ EcoTec Combi Natural Gas Boiler
product.description: With an ErP A rating and impressive up to 94% efficiency, the Vaillant Green IQ EcoTec Combi Natural Gas Boiler is the ideal choice for those who are environmentally conscious and budget-savvy. product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper Slip Coupling
product.description: The Geberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for all sorts of plumbing applications.
